snippet.title: 900 - Gameplay Video | Desktop, iOS, Android
snippet.description:
900 is a circular swiping game for Android, iOS, Windows, Mac and Linux in which the player controls an entity that must absorb universes in order to grow endlessly.

Website: http://www.barnaque.com/900-en/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/barnaque/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BarnaqueJeux
